title: OS command execution via SHELL (basic) — review required
description: The basic sink SHELL launches processes. Untrusted input in the command becomes command injection. This lexical rule flags the sink; the reviewer confirms arguments are trusted or passed as vectors via ShellExecute with validated input.
remediation: Use ShellExecute with validated input with separate arguments, never interpolated command strings.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: any SHELL call matches.
